text: Skip to main content About Form 8822-B, Change of Address or Responsible Party - Business More In Forms and Instructions Current year Prior year Accessible eBooks Browser-friendly forms and publications Mobile-friendly forms Post release changes to forms Order forms and publications Help with forms and instructions Comment on tax forms and publications Form 8822-B is for businesses and other entities with an Employer Identification Number application on file. Use Form 8822-B to notify the Internal Revenue Service if you changed: Business mailing address. Business location. Identity of your responsible party. Note: Changes in responsible parties must be reported to the IRS within 60 days. Current Revision Form 8822-B PDF Recent Developments None at this time.
